`economy-v1.wasm` is the pre-player-shop local contract artifact captured before this state migration. The migration regression deploys it, creates a listing and receipt, upgrades to the current build, then compares all old snapshot fields and the immutable receipt. It is a test fixture, not a deployment target.

`economy-pre-capacity.wasm` is the contract built from commit 0a3f96a (`build/dungeon-loop` before bounded storage merged, docs/systems/CAPACITY.md), with lifetime caps on runs, listings, batches, editions and receipts. The upgrade regression in `tests/contract/long-lived.test.ts` deploys it, records listings, commissions, runs and receipts, upgrades in place without migration, and checks that the snapshot is unchanged, old receipts still replay, and new listing and commission ids never reuse old ones. Test fixture only.
